'''[[India]]''' participated in the '''[[2016 South Asian Games]]''' in [[Guwahati]] and [[Shillong]], [[India]] from 5 to 16 February 2016.<ref>{{cite web|date=17 February 2016|title=SAG 2016 Final Result|url=http://southasiangames2016.nic.in/includes/SAG_Final_Results.pdf|url-status=bot: unknown|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221028114701/http://southasiangames2016.nic.in/includes/SAG_Final_Results.pdf|archive-date=28 October 2022|access-date=16 November 2021}}</ref>

==Medal summary==
India won 188 gold medals and a total of 308 medals.<ref>{{cite web|title=Results: Medal Tally|url=http://www.southasiangames2016.com/|publisher=[[South Asian Games]]|accessdate=14 February 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160320184016/http://www.southasiangames2016.com/|archive-date=20 March 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref>

*'''NR''' = National record
*N/A = Round not applicable for the event
